annotations.title: Polyrank AI Lab: a paper run

description: A paper run by id with the grader's stats (copies, resolved, P&L per $10 (per10 × 10 = % per copied trade), entry vs the leader, the paper gate) and its copies, each with its fate (copied / no_fill / leader_sold / capped / skipped + reason). Needs a signed-in Polyrank account. Strategies, backtests, paper runs and chats exist only on a plan with the AI Lab (every paid plan, from Pro Trader: https://polyrank.app/pricing).
